result.title: RingCentral Scales Customer Programs with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
“ChatGPT Work helped me scale from six customers that I was tracking in the pilot phase to about 80.”

Vaneet Seth, R&D Efficiency Manager at RingCentral, uses ChatGPT Work to bring together information across siloed teams, turn scattered knowledge into a living operating system, and move from insights to execution faster.

Check out how ChatGPT Work can work for you: http://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/

result.title: Stampli scales product marketing with ChatGPT Work
result.description:
“It’s allowed basically a one-person team to do the work of a team of four or five.”

Melad Zahedi, Director of Product Marketing at Stampli, uses ChatGPT Work to pull product context from Jira, GitHub, and meeting notes, then automatically update downstream content across help centers, presentations, web pages, and more.

The result? Hundreds of pieces of content each week—and more time to focus on strategic work.

Check out how ChatGPT Work can work for you: http://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/
